prompt_text: Use the first transparent source contact sheet as six references in reading order, two columns by three rows. Preserve exact row mapping: row 1: Mountain ridge (highlands-mountain-ridge); row 2: Mountain cliff wall (highlands-mountain-cliff-wall); row 3: Mountain cliff corner (highlands-mountain-cliff-corner); row 4: Mountain stone slope (highlands-mountain-stone-slope); row 5: Snowy peak (highlands-snowy-peak); row 6: Snow cliff wall (highlands-snow-cliff-wall). The second transparent center-dot image indicates exact 6 columns by 6 rows; do not reproduce dots. Columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Ridges, cliffs, slopes and peaks are fixed geological masses. TOP and BOTTOM are true overhead/underside ground footprints, not front-facing cliff/peak artwork; side elevations show cliff-face direction and thickness. Preserve exact ridge/corner/slope shapes and snow coverage. Strict axis-aligned orthographic, not isometric/three-quarter. Front and rear broad elevations; right/left side elevations. TOP camera looks straight down along Z at footprint; BOTTOM straight up along Z at underside, occluding vertical height. Preserve source identities, palette, materials, shapes and proportions. One complete centered object per cell, no duplicates or neighbors. Transparent background, no text, labels, lines, grid, border, scenery or shadow; no clipping/leakage. Unseen surfaces conservatively inferred, not recovered pixels.
